lastResponse.text: First step: call the Oregon City Overnight Winter Warming Shelter now at five zero three, seven two two, nine seven eight zero. Ask if they’re open tonight and if they have a bed for a 19-year-old. It’s at 603 twelfth Street, Oregon City, for adults 18 and older, no documents required. It opens when overnight wind chill is 33 degrees or below. If you feel in immediate danger where you are, call nine one one right now.
originalTexts: First step: call the Oregon City Overnight Winter Warming Shelter now at **five zero three, seven two two, nine seven eight zero**. Ask if they’re open tonight and if they have a bed for a 19-year-old. It’s at **603 12th Street, Oregon City**, for adults 18 and older, no documents required. It opens when overnight wind chill is **33 degrees or below**. If you feel in immediate danger where you are, call **911** right now.
